# Psalm 96 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 96:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Declare among-the-nations his-glory, among-all the-peoples his-wonders.
- **LOGOS:** Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!
- **PNEUMA:** Announce his glory to the nations, his amazing deeds to every people group.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 96:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Say among-the-nations, 'YHWH reigns!' Also is-established the-world not it-will-be-moved; he-will-judge the-peoples with-equity.
- **LOGOS:** Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!" Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved; he shall judge the peoples with equity.
- **PNEUMA:** Tell the nations: 'The LORD is king!' The world stands firm and cannot be shaken. He will judge the peoples fairly.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** Let the heavens celebrate and the earth be glad! Let the sea and everything in it roar with praise!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 96:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Before YHWH for he-comes, for he-comes to-judge the-earth; he-will-judge the-world in-righteousness, and-peoples in-his-faithfulness.
- **LOGOS:** before the LORD, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.
- **PNEUMA:** because the LORD is coming! He's coming to judge the earth! He will judge the world with righteousness and the nations with his truth.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
